summary: iter358 Caja/POS COBRO testing complete. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS, frontend Playwright E2E PASS. Verified: new POST /admin/pos/cobro endpoint registers venta movement + atomically decrements stock + always sets open_drawer=true, ESC/POS contains drawer kick + logo raster, 400 on stock insuficiente (no stock change), 400 on fractional qty for unit product, unit_price override vs default price_usd, auth gating. Frontend: pos-cobro section lists products, cobro-total = price×qty, cobrar() → toast + preview dialog with [ LOGO ] + drawer note (always) + logo note, sales list and stock in select refresh after sale. SUN-03-B regression HOLDS: reprint of a saved sale with drawer toggle ON does NOT include drawer note; sample ticket DOES respect toggle. SUNMI transport correctly fails-closed with explicit JS USDK error, no false OK.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: visual-editor instrumentation injects <span> inside <option> for products in cobro-product-select (console warning only, not functional). Not a regression of this iter.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/pos.py pos_cobro correctly reuses create_movement (atomic stock debit, audit, VIP/fraction validation) and forces open_drawer=True in the ReceiptPayload — the toggle cfg.openDrawer is intentionally NOT forwarded from the frontend cobrar() payload, consistent with the product rule.
Frontend cobrar() calls toast + loadSales() + loadProducts() BEFORE awaiting route(), so the sales list and select stock refresh regardless of transport outcome (good for SUNMI-fail-closed UX).
SUN-03-B invariant preserved in InventoryPrintTab.printSale(): forces open_drawer:false in the build payload, independent of cfg.openDrawer; verified in UI with toggle ON.

Side-effect semantics in SUNMI transport: a cobro in SUNMI already mutates stock before the print transport fails. This is the documented/intended behavior ('la venta ya quedó registrada aunque la impresión falle') — flagged here only for E1 awareness, not a bug.
